about.introduction:
Computer Engineering student at the University of Toronto, building developer tools, business software, and interactive projects. My recent work spans Rust asset processing, desktop terminals, visual Git review, and trade operations with read-only access for AI tools. I focus on clear boundaries between user decisions, application state, and external systems.
Away from code: films, music, fiction, games, and esports.

aio-asset-normalizer.coverAlt: 柔和侧光下的浅色石质雕塑，中央有一个深色圆形开口。
aio-asset-normalizer.description: A Rust desktop and CLI toolkit for preparing game-ready GLB assets: inspect and edit models, retarget BVH or GLB motion, replace PBR textures, and batch-convert authoring files through Blender.
fullProjectHighlights: GLB editing, animation trimming, and validated export
BVH and GLB retargeting through a shared Mapping v2 contract
A headless JSON CLI backed by the desktop domain code
aio-asset-normalizer.title: AIO Asset Normalizer

battle-royal-moba.description: A top-down 2.5D MOBA game built around a clear separation between authoritative gameplay simulation and real-time presentation.
fullProjectHighlights: 权威模拟架构
玩家与机器人共享的指令管线
C++ 与 Godot 的数据流
battle-royal-moba.title: Battle Royal Moba Game

dinosaur-game.description: An embedded systems project featuring a dinosaur game implemented on an STM32 MCU with custom graphics and input handling.
dinosaur-game.title: Dinosaur Game

gis-route-optimization.description: A geographic information system built with C++ and GTK, featuring real-time pathfinding algorithms and interactive map visualization.
fullProjectHighlights: Dijkstra 与 A* 路径规划
多站点路线优化策略
结合交通信息的地图体验
gis-route-optimization.title: GIS Route Optimization Application

greedy-mouse-game.description: An FPGA project featuring a game implemented with Verilog, custom graphics, and hardware input handling.
greedy-mouse-game.title: Greedy Mouse Game

license-plate-recognition.description: An Ontario-style license plate recognition system trained with PyTorch, combining a CNN bounding-box layer and a CRNN character-recognition layer.
license-plate-recognition.title: License Plate Recognition System

runner-game.description: An embedded systems project featuring a runner game implemented on a RISC-V processor with custom graphics and input handling.
runner-game.title: Runner Game

streamfile-server.description: A database-free file server with Markdown reading, media playback, subtitle conversion, folder uploads, and filename search. A Bun backend and React interface ship together in standalone executables.
streamfile-server.title: StreamFile Server
fullProjectHighlights: Filesystem browsing, Markdown, and subtitled media playback
Staged uploads with collision-safe publishing
Standalone binaries with embedded frontend assets

tradeflow-system.description: A trade and inventory workspace connecting purchases, sales, stock movements, settlements, and FIFO profit analysis, with a read-only MCP service and a desktop assistant for connecting business data to external agents.
fullProjectHighlights: Transaction-backed inventory and FIFO cost analysis
Account-scoped, read-only MCP access to business data
TradeFlow Connect with verified setup and recovery
tradeflow-system.title: TradeFlow

geared-term.title: Geared Term
geared-term.description: A desktop terminal bringing local shells, SSH, SFTP, and an AI conversation into one workspace. Terminal context is shared explicitly, credentials stay in an encrypted vault, and suggested commands remain under user control.
fullProjectHighlights: Local and SSH terminals with integrated file transfer
Encrypted credentials and validated Electron process boundaries
Context-aware AI chat with separate Copy, Insert, and Run actions

augur-git.title: Augur Git
augur-git.description: A review-first desktop Git client for changes produced by editors and coding agents. The Tauri app combines navigable diffs, commit history, revision comparison, and a compact Sidecar layout with prompts for external agents.
fullProjectHighlights: Working-tree review, commit graphs, and revision comparison
A compact Sidecar workspace beside a terminal or editor
Typed Git operations and context-aware agent prompt handoff
